source_quote: For our store entity, the properties might include the region it belongs to, its square footage, or its priority classification for the supply chain. And then we have to connect them. That brings us to relationships. Relationships define the verbs between the nouns. They explain how different entity types interact in the real world. Give me an example. You might define a relationship that states a store operates a refrigeration unit or a supplier ships a product. You are drawing explicit lines of meaning so the AI doesn't have to guess how a supplier and a store are connected.
